---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement for PDFistic
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: ["devanshd07o"]
---

### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is (e.g., "I'm always frustrated when trying to...").

### Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how you envision this feature working within PDFistic.

### Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered or seen in other tools.

### Visual Mockups or References
If you have sketches, mockups, or examples from other applications, please paste them here.

### Context
Who would benefit most from this feature? (e.g., academic researchers, legal professionals, casual book readers).
